newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's cement output rises by 6.3 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's cement output rises by 6.3 pct in 1996.

text.p: Turkish cement production rose by 6.3 percent to 35,232,949 tonnes in 1996 compared to 33,143,390 tonnes in 1995, the cement manufacturers' union said on Thursday.
It said 32,087,477 tonnes of cement was sold on the domestic market last year, a rise of 6.66 percent from the previous year, and 3,095,129 tonnes of cement was exported, an increase of 2.35 percent.
Clinker output firmed to 27,851,775 tonnes last year from 1995's 27,095,539 tonnes.Clinker exports fell to 602,886 tonnes from previous 1,604,257 tonnes.
There were no clinker or cement imports in 1996.
